description: Self-authored focused render comparisons. These are not the Web Platform Tests and do not establish browser conformance.

cases.name: overflow-clip
cases.description: Overflow clips descendants at the padding edge and restores clipping for a following sibling.

cases.name: fractional-grid-gap
cases.description: Fractional grid tracks share space in a 1:2 ratio after subtracting a gap.

cases.name: box-model
cases.description: Content width/height, padding, solid border and margins produce the specified outer rectangle.

cases.name: cascade-inheritance
cases.description: An important selector beats inline color; descendants inherit font size and selected children override color.

cases.name: flex-grow-gap
cases.description: Flex distributes remaining width in a 1:2 ratio after subtracting the inter-item gap.

cases.name: grid-tracks
cases.description: Two explicit grid column tracks and a gap place four cells in two rows.

cases.name: hidden-template
cases.description: Hidden attributes, display:none subtrees and template contents contribute no paint or flow height.

cases.name: preformatted-lines
cases.description: Preformatted spaces and an explicit newline retain spaces and use the specified line height.

cases.name: table-default-spacing
cases.description: The implicit tbody and two rows use explicit cell widths with the default 2px table spacing.

cases.name: media-custom-properties
cases.description: A matching screen-width media rule selects a custom property used by the background shorthand.

cases.name: flex-min-max-freezing
cases.description: Min/max constraints redistribute growth and shrinkage; scaled shrink excludes padding.

cases.name: flex-reverse-order-alignment
cases.description: Row reversal starts at the right edge; order is stable and align-self overrides container alignment.

cases.name: flex-column-reverse-freezing
cases.description: Column reversal places constrained grown items from the bottom and applies per-item cross alignment.

cases.name: float-line-exclusion
cases.description: A left float excludes its right and bottom margins from two lines; following inline boxes regain the full width.

cases.name: float-opposite-lines
cases.description: Left and right floats shorten the first line from both sides and expire at their independent bottoms.

cases.name: float-clear-margins
cases.description: Same-side floats pack using noncollapsed margins, drop when necessary, and clear:left differs from clear:both. The right float paints over a normal block background.

cases.name: float-shrink-to-fit
cases.description: Auto float width is the preferred width when space permits and the available width between preferred minimum and preferred maximum; padding and float containment affect height.

cases.name: float-formatting-context
cases.description: An overflow-hidden block avoids an outside float, isolates its own inner float, and does not move a following clear below unrelated internal geometry.

cases.name: float-text-lines
cases.description: Monospace text wraps into two shortened lines followed by a full-width line, compared with independently positioned complete text lines.

cases.name: grid-explicit-spans
cases.description: Signed explicit lines and row/column spans determine distinct areas.

cases.name: grid-dense-placement
cases.description: Dense placement fills earlier holes left by two-column spans.

cases.name: grid-column-implicit
cases.description: Column auto-placement adds tracks using grid-auto-columns while preserving row spans.

cases.name: grid-minmax-fraction
cases.description: A minimum freezes the first fractional column; fixed-height fractional rows divide remaining space.

cases.name: grid-intrinsic-spans
cases.description: Overlapping spanning contributions determine intrinsic track widths before item placement.

cases.name: grid-track-item-alignment
cases.description: Content alignment moves tracks; self alignment and auto margins position border-box items inside them.

cases.name: grid-implicit-negative
cases.description: Implicit tracks before and after the explicit grid cycle through the declared track sizes.
